name: Creai
one_liner: Turn a video on your own YouTube channel into interactive prompts, review them, and make them live, all from Claude.
description:
Creai adds interactive prompts to a creator's YouTube videos. With this connector, Claude can list the videos on your connected channel, check how many generations you have left, start a generation for one video, show you the generated prompts and answer options for review, make a reviewed version live for viewers, and give you the public watch link.

What you need: a Creai account and a YouTube channel you own, connected to Creai in the console. Claude cannot create accounts or connect YouTube for you; when the channel is not connected, Claude gives you the console link to do it.

What Claude can do: read your workspaces, videos, allowance and generations; start a generation on your own channel (it uses one video of your allowance); make a generation live, which changes what viewers see.

What Claude cannot do: work on channels you do not own, delete anything, disconnect YouTube, change billing or account settings, or publish without your instruction.
example_prompts: Which of my YouTube videos don't have interactive prompts yet, and how many generations do I have left?
Generate interactive prompts for my latest video, then show me the prompts so I can review them before anything goes live.
Make the generation I just reviewed live and give me the watch link to share.
auth: OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration; sign in when needed
data_handling: Own first-party API (console.withcreai.app). No personal health data. No sponsored content.
use_cases: Turn a video on your own channel into interactive prompts
Review generated prompts and answer options before viewers see them
Publish a reviewed version and share the public watch link
needs_before_connecting: A Creai account and a YouTube channel you own, connected in the Creai console.
reviewer_test_account_instructions: Sam provides credentials in the portal; demo workspace only, no real creator data

icon_note.native_size_px: 32x32 (square vector, viewBox 0 0 32 32, rounded dark tile with green ring and play mark)
icon_note.action: Export to a square PNG (for example 512x512) for the portal upload; the repo holds no raster icon. The portal's icon size rules are not stated in the docs read, so check the upload field.
